page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword/signature line at foot ("I 5" at left and "spem" at right, the latter a catchword). Small marks in left margin are show-through or stray marks and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: matura deliberatione iniri possint, ab istius Celsitudine postulabit, ut conventum aliquem in Germania haberi, & de communi Illustrissimorum Principum confensu, curet, & diem ab ipsis præscribi, quo Serenissima Anglia Regina & Serenissimi Regis Dania legati, una cum Illustrissimorum Germaniæ Principum legatis adesse possint, cui etiam conventui per legatos nostros minime defuturi sumus.

Porro hoc etiam Illustrissimo Electori nostro nomine significari cupimus, non frustra, neque temere a nobis ineunte superiore anno susceptum fuisse Germania perlustrandæ institutum ut concordiæ & conjunctionis alicujus rationes quæremus,cum in utraque illa Ecclesiarum salutem & incolumitatem(quę nobis suprema lex esse debet) verti agnoscant omnes, absque illis vero servari non posse adversus Antichristi molitiones,nemo sanæ mentis putet. Utriusque vero negotii perficiendi

page.notes: Printed text is set in italic in parts; the running head reads "Reg. Gall. ad Imp. &c." Page number 201 is printed at top right. The catchword "spem" and signature "I 5" appear at the foot. The leftmost marks in the margin are stray marks, not notes.
